context: Highest coastal erosion in Odisha. 6 of 7 original panchayat villages lost since 1960s; 571 families relocated in 2018 to Bagapatia colony 12 km inland.
mitigation_status: Population relocated; no active erosion control at original site

context: Second-highest erosion in Odisha, ~15 km from Satabhaya. Lost 800m of beach in 2008; geo-synthetic sea wall built but reportedly degrading.
mitigation_status: Geo-synthetic tube sea wall constructed (partially degraded)
source: Lok Sabha reply Dec 2023 / Down To Earth

context: Moderate erosion recorded at Aryapalli beach, Ganjam district; mid-severity reference point.
